parts: I was looking through the documentation but I didn't find the answer, what is the difference between inla.mode="classic" and inla.mode="experimental"?

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] whats the difference between inla.mode="classic" and ="experimental"?
parts:
The "experimental" mode is the old name for the current default
"compact" mode (default since around Dec/Jan 2022/23 I believe).
It is based on a variational approximation in the final calculation
steps (the inner Laplace approximation is still there); see
https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0167947323000038
that refers to
https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.12945
for further details.

Finn
